reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `phone-normalize` (`173e408`):

*P1 — Only the first space is removed* — `src/normalize.js:4`
`replace(' ', '')` leaves subsequent spaces behind, so `queueText` rejects *all three examples documented in the README*, including `+44 20 7946 0958` and `+1 (415) 555-0100`.

*Recommended fix:* remove spaces globally, and add tests that pass the README examples through `queueText`. The current normalization test contains only one space, so it misses this.

All 5 existing tests pass; I separately reproduced the three failures. No code changed.
